quest.title: Inazuma Sales Specialist
quest.description: Vahid, the owner of the Syavushi Bakshesh Shoppe, is currently having a headache over sales...

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: This business is so hard. All my merchandise is good and they're the real deal...

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: But why does no one here want to buy anything?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What is the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you, Traveler. *sigh* Forget it. I still cannot sell any fertilizer...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't you have Alrani to help you?

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: She did help me out a little. But trouble is, neither of us knows how to promote these goods. We can only wait for the customers to show up...

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: And you know about the situation in Ritou. Nobody is buying anything.

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: So I visited the gentlemen at the merchant guild to ask for help, and they suggested that we do something called marketing.

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Simply put, they want us to talk more about the fertilizer's effects and the theory behind it with customers. We should also do more data-driven promotion, and we should offer a "free trial" service...

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: But... I really don't understand such complex matters. And I'm not the one who created this fertilizer, so how can I possibly explain it?

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Anyway, even if it's just reciting the instructions, I believe I'll still need to run around and do some promotion.

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Alrani is already out there promoting our goods. I am going out later as well. Traveler, could you please help us out?

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: Excellent! We are counting on you, Traveler.

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: The place you are going to is called Konda Village. It's not far from here.

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: There is a gentleman named Konda Densuke who has shown some interest in our fertilizer. He also came to the store to chat with me a little earlier.

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: If you could promote some of our goods at his place and offer him a free trial, he might just buy some fertilizer.

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: She said that she needed to collect some materials and that she'll have to go quite far away.

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: The place you are going to is called Konda Village. It's not far from here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, tell me how to use the fertilizer...

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Oh yes, right, I haven't explained it to you yet. The fertilizer you are taking there must be used in a certain way.

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Now, let me see... according to the manual, the order should be...

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: You must first add <color=#37FFFF>water</color> to the fertilizer, before adding some <color=#37FFFF>crushed leaves</color>. Finally, <color=#37FFFF>mix them well</color> and apply it to the field.

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Don't get the order wrong, or it may cause problems, which will affect our customers' impression of us. Our future business is at stake...

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: Then I'm counting on you. Once you deliver the Anahitian Blessing to the customer, his first payment will be yours to keep.

choices.text: Could you repeat the process again?

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: You must first add <color=#37FFFF>water</color> to the fertilizer, before adding some <color=#37FFFF>crushed leaves</color>. Finally, <color=#37FFFF>mix them well</color> and apply it to the field.

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: I'm counting on you, Traveler... Let's all work hard. With any luck, business this month might be good!

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: Youngsters, we meet again. What would you like to know this time?

choices.text: I'm not here to ask questions this time.

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: Oh, did Vahid send you?

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: I heard about a novel fertilizer shop in Ritou. That's why I went to meet Mr. Vahid to try out his fertilizer.

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: If it works and increases crop production, there might be hope for restoring Konda Village.

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: Heh, I guess it is still up to an old relic such as myself to restore the village. Those young lads from the village... Hmph! You can't count on them.

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: Alright, tell me then. How should I use this fertilizer?

choices.text: Add water first, then add crushed leaves before mixing them up.

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: Such a complicated procedure for fertilizer... Alright, I've got it.

choices.text: Add crushed leaves first, then mix them, and add water at the end.
Add crushed leaves, then add water, then mix them up.
I'm here to talk about how to use the fertilizer.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: That's what Vahid told me last time, too. It should be alright. I'll wait for the crops to grow.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: I've got a bad feeling about this somehow. It doesn't sound like what Vahid said last time. Are you sure there won't be any problems?
